item.title: Hat-trick! Ronaldo reaches 985 against Al Kholood — just 15 to go to 1,000
item.description:
🔥 Denied twice by offside flags before the break, Cristiano Ronaldo struck back with a second-half hat-trick (66', 72', 82') as Al Nassr beat Al Kholood 5-3. His first competitive hat-trick since May 2024 — and only 15 goals now stand between him and 1,000.
#CR7 #Ronaldo #Triple #Kholood #Football
